properties.Name: Lighthouse of Alexandria
properties.Details: The poem reflects on the grandeur and symbolic importance of the city and the lighthouse as a beacon of Alexandrian identity.

properties.Name: Serapeum of Alexandria
properties.Details: Discussed as a symbolic and historical center of Alexandrian religious life.

properties.Name: El Raml Station
properties.Poem: "In the Street", "The Windows of the Tobacco Shop"
properties.Details: Inspired David Hockney's paintings, this part of the city also known as Quartier Attarine, represents the bustling energy of Alexandria’s urban life.

properties.Name: Le Metropole Hotel
properties.Details: Cavafy's office used to be here, close to Billiards Palace where he met lovers.

properties.Name: Cavafy House
properties.Details: The house Cavafy lived and wrote his poems. It is now a museum.

properties.Name: Greek Orthodox Cathedral
properties.Details: Key cultural and religious site for Alexandrian Greek Orthodox Christians.
